static_review.deadline: One fixed absolute solver deadline, capped by the outer deadline; first call and all recovery work consume it.
static_review.exception_filter: Only matching BoxBoxGradient RuntimeError/SystemExit permits retry; unrelated BaseException propagates after evidence capture.
static_review.normal_failure: An unsuccessful or nonfinite returned result is retained without retry; strict existing candidate validation remains required.
static_review.query_retry_scope: The refiner shares guarded/restarts/invocations across all rounds. Maximum 4 refinement rounds, at most one exceptional aborted call in addition.
static_review.logs: First exception solver log is renamed with overwrite refusal; the second call uses a fresh original filename. Refined round evidence remains in its round directory and top-level pointers are rebased.
static_review.old_key_compatibility: Unified results/CLI do not consume old maximum_native_solves. Candidate refinement_native_solves remains as actual invocation count; refinement_rounds is separate. Existing historical source snapshots, immutable reports and result records remain untouched.
static_review.resolved_draft_issue: The first draft raised on ordinary nonfinite solver results and would have changed failure classification to infrastructure_error; latest implementation returns the original result and records finiteness.

scope_limit: Static review and a real Drake-binding transaction with injected solver behavior. No real optimizer, collision query, GPU query, or formal benchmark was run by this reviewer. Historical actual BoxBox solve and real normal-solve validation are performed separately by nto_correctness.
